feeds.title: Travels of Adam » Fashion
feeds.description: I'm a hipster travel blogger & one-time graphic designer. Read travel fashion tips including packing lists and seasonal recommendations on the latest fashion trends & styles perfect for stylish travelers. On this travel blog, you'll find my gay stories, nightlife tips, restaurant reviews, product recs, and all-too-personal essays from my adventures in NYC and around the world.

feeds.title: DapperQ
feeds.description: DapperQ is one of the world's most widely read digital queer style magazines and is a preeminent voice in queer fashion and beauty. We inspire people of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and gender presentations to think differently about both queer fashion and beauty as art and visual activism, and ultimately have a deeper, more fulfilling relationship with style.

feeds.title: Tom + Lorenzo » Style
feeds.description: Fabulous & opinionated, Tom + Lorenzo is your place for more news, gossip, and other gems that didn't make the blog cut. Read about new styles, trends, and more on Tom + Lorenzo.

feeds.title: Qwear Fashion
feeds.description: Qwear Fashion is the first online LGBTQIA+ style incubator. The birthplace of the #ThisIsWhatAsexualLooksLike Movement, Qwear Fashion has been a space for fashion and gender activists to gather and form a community since 2011.

feeds.title: PRIDE » Gay Fashion
feeds.description: Let's face it. No one does fashion better than the LGBT community. Pride is your best source for all things fierce, fun, and chic in the fashion industry! PRIDE is a community of gay, bisexual, lesbian, trans, and questioning people and their friends. We talk about trending stories you'll want to share!

feeds.title: Oh Anthonio
feeds.description: Hey! What's Up? Hello, I'm Anthony Urbano and welcome to my blog! A creative space to share my perspective on all things fashion, lifestyle, food, travel and fun, I'm excited to take you with me so I hope you'll stick around!

feeds.title: Gayletter » Fashion
feeds.description: Gayletter.com updates daily with interesting interviews, party photos, and videos from the Gayletter team.

feeds.title: BosGuy » Fashion
feeds.description: I'm a gay, urban, foodie and travel nut from Boston who wants to see the world and make some friends along the way. Although I started blogging more to chronicle important events in my life and for the occasional political rant, it has evolved into a hobby.

feeds.title: Gay Desert Guide » Fashion & Style
feeds.description: Check out the fashion and Style in beautiful Palm Springs in the Gay Desert Guide. Palm Springs has great fashion for clothing and the home. Gay Desert Guide is a mobile & online guide to discovering LGBTQ Palm Springs. Like our page and you'll know what's happening in the Greater Palm Springs area - from Joshua Tree to the Salton Sea and everywhere in between.

feeds.title: GAY TIMES » Fashion
feeds.description: Gay Times has been a vital resource for the LGBTQ community from its genesis in 1984. Our website includes the latest LGBTQ community news, the very best entertainment exclusives, and essential travel and style features.

feeds.title: Out Magazine » Gay Fashion
feeds.description: Out is the leading authority on gay fashion. Discover the latest trends, looks, accessories, and more shown off on the hottest male models. See fashion fresh from the runway, learn the rules of gay style from Out's sartorial experts, and learn how gay designers have shaped the fashion industry around the world.
